title: 1312 Interactive 完成 100 万美元种子轮融资
content:
1312 Interactive raises $1m in seed funding round | GamesIndustry.biz

.
Publishing house 1312 Interactive has secured $1 million in a seed funding round.
The round was led by T-Accelerate Capital and ChimeraVC, with participation from Ventana Ventures, Rahul Reddy G., Rohan Murukutla, and Dasari Srinivas. The funds will support 1312 Interactive's publishing infrastructure.
This includes expansion into emerging markets and ongoing support for developers in production, marketing, QA, localisation, and distribution.
1312 Interactive is also launching 1312 Playground, a community-led initiative that offers studios access to playtesting, feedback, and audience insights before launch.
Founded in 2024 by Deepak Gurijala and Raviteja Mantena, 1312 Interactive is India's first dedicated PC and console game publishing house.
The company publicly launched its operations in February 2025,
alongside the announcement that it closed its pre-seed funding
.
1312 Interactive published
Winds of Arcana: Ruination
(Brewed Games) in 2025 and
Palm Sugar: A Village Story
(Mono Tusk Studios) last month.
Souls of Bombarika
(Street Lamp Games) and We Are So Cooked (Dwarven Brothers) are scheduled for release in October.
Prescription Studios'
Spaceman Biff
will also be published by 1312 Interactive.
